name: Premier Umalas 16 — Stylish 3BR Pool Townhouse
description: Premier Umalas 16 is a three-bedroom townhouse in the quiet lanes of Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak, finished in dark stone and warm wood. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom and a desk by the window; the enclosed living room and the kitchen with its island are air-conditioned, and glass doors open onto a private pool and a small planted courtyard. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps, and with three separate workspaces the house is set up for people staying for months as much as for a holiday. Washing machine, safe and iron are on site. Sleeps 6.
address: Jl.Umalas n89, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Индонезия

name: Premier Umalas 17 — Stylish 2BR Private Pool Home

Both bedrooms are en-suite and have their own balconies. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and the house has two separate workspaces, which makes it work for a couple staying for months as much as for a short holiday. Fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning and a Smart TV. Berawa and Canggu beaches are about 10 minutes away by bike. Sleeps 4.

Open-plan living room with a Smart TV and fully equipped kitchen opening onto a large private pool through full-height glass doors; a wide first-floor balcony overlooks the garden. Fast Wi-Fi, a safe in every room and housekeeping three times a week are included. Sleeps up to 12 — suited to large families, groups of friends, weddings and company retreats.

Four bedrooms — the master on the ground floor with a pool view, three more upstairs — each with a king bed and its own en-suite bathroom, plus a separate guest toilet. The enclosed living and kitchen area is air-conditioned, with a large sofa, Smart TV and a dining table for eight, and opens through sliding glass doors onto a 35 m² private pool with four sunbeds and a garden. Fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, filtered drinking water, private parking and housekeeping three times a week are included. Sleeps up to 8 — suited to families and to two or three families travelling together.

name: Eco Private — Teak 1BR Pool Villa in Ungasan
description: A one-bedroom villa in Ungasan on the Bukit peninsula, built almost entirely from natural teak and wrapped in tropical planting. Step out of the bedroom and you are at a private pool set in a garden; the air-conditioned living area with a Smart TV runs into a kitchen with a bar counter, and the bathroom has its own garden outlook and a free-standing tub. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and there is a desk by the window, so the villa works for remote work as much as for a slow holiday. Scooter parking, housekeeping three times a week and a laundry pick-up service are included; the beaches of the south coast are around ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.
